responsibility: Provides the implementation of byte-stream compression used for LTO section payloads. It defines the callback-driven lto_compression_stream buffer, accumulates raw section bytes, normalizes the user-selected compression level, and performs final compression or decompression with zlib or zstd while updating LTO size statistics and timing counters. This file is the codec backend used by LTO section readers and writers; it does not define section layout, only how already-formed LTO data blocks are compressed and expanded.
same_name_distinction: Implements the same-stem compression API declared in gcc/lto-compress.h: it defines the private lto_compression_stream representation and performs the actual zlib/zstd compression and decompression work, rather than just exposing the callback-based interface.
